Messages.Author: PetriWessman
Messages.Body:
Can CrimethInc be used after a successful action to equip with a Stolen Police Cruiser, i.e. is it considered an "action that requires an anarch"? There is no specific "requires anarch" text there, but it does have "Only usable by an anarch.".

Side question: if it is not considered to require an anarch, could a non-anarch minion equip it, and then later use it when they become anarch?

Stolen Police Cruiser
[Equipment] Equipment
Vehicle.
Only usable by an anarch. This anarch gets +1 bleed. Allies and younger vampires get -1 intercept when attempting to block this anarch. Any vampire can burn this card as a  action that costs 1 pool. If that action is successful, this anarch is tapped and doesn't untap as normal during his or her next untap phase. A minion may have only one vehicle.

CrimethInc.
[Action Modifier] Action Modifier
[Protean] Protean
[Quietus] Quietus
[Thaumaturgy] Thaumaturgy
Requires an anarch. Play after resolving a successful action that requires an anarch or makes this vampire an anarch.
[pro] Untap this anarch.
[qui] Untap another ready anarch.
[tha] Put this card in play. During your minion phase, you may burn a pool to untap a ready anarch you control.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Anyone can equip it. Only an anarch can use it.
